qa_pairs.question: What section of the BMW E30 M3 service manual covers troubleshooting engine electrical and DME issues?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 12-108 covers troubleshooting engine electric and DME.

qa_pairs.question: What diagnostic system is used for troubleshooting engine electrical and DME problems since the introduction of M 1.1?
qa_pairs.answer: BMW Diagnosis Test is used for troubleshooting engine electrical and DME problems since the introduction of M 1.1.

qa_pairs.question: Where can the increment wheel for single-sender Motronic be found?
qa_pairs.answer: The increment wheel (1) for single-sender Motronic is recognizable on the increment wheel and is shown in the diagram.

qa_pairs.question: What component is labeled as item 1 in the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Item 1 in the diagram is the increment wheel for single-sender Motronic.

qa_pairs.question: What type of Motronic system does this increment wheel apply to?
qa_pairs.answer: This increment wheel applies to single-sender Motronic systems.

qa_pairs.question: How is the increment wheel identified in the engine bay?
qa_pairs.answer: The increment wheel is recognizable on the increment wheel itself for single-sender Motronic systems.

qa_pairs.question: What engine management system version introduced the use of BMW Diagnosis Test?
qa_pairs.answer: BMW Diagnosis Test has been used since the introduction of M 1.1.

qa_pairs.question: What is the main focus of this troubleshooting section?
qa_pairs.answer: This section focuses on troubleshooting engine electric and DME (Digital Motor Electronics) systems.

qa_pairs.question: What visual method is used to show the increment wheel location?
qa_pairs.answer: A black and white photograph with an arrow pointing to the increment wheel (labeled as 1) is used to show its location.
